qualifier: pexophagy and nitrogen-starvation response
name: Selective autophagy with pexophagy and phagophore assembly
rationale: All members concern autophagosome/phagophore formation for selective cargo (peroxisomes, mitochondria, nucleus) or starvation-induced autophagy; pexophagy, nitrogen response and ATG8 delipidation separate it from the regulatory, aggrephagy/CMA, PINK1-mitophagy and reticulophagy neighbours.

qualifier: IL-12-driven Th1 and regulatory T cell polarization
name: IL-12-driven Th1 and regulatory T cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover IL-12/IFN-gamma-driven Th1 commitment and Treg (FOXP3) differentiation with suppression of Th2/Th17 fates, which separates it from the dendritic-cell, IFN-gamma signalling, NKT and T cell tolerance neighbours.

qualifier: G-CSF-driven neutrophil lineage
name: G-CSF-driven neutrophil differentiation from myeloid progenitors
rationale: All members describe commitment of myeloid progenitors to neutrophilic granulocytes with G-CSF and retinoic acid receptor signalling, distinguishing it from eosinophil/mast, RUNX transcription and M-CSF macrophage neighbours.

qualifier: PGC-1alpha, gluconeogenesis and caloric restriction
name: PGC-1alpha-linked metabolic adaptation to fasting and caloric restriction
rationale: Members combine PGC-1alpha/PPARA and clock nuclear receptor (ROR/REV-ERB) transcription with gluconeogenesis, caloric restriction, redox and acetylation responses, which neighbours focused on LXR lipid homeostasis or BMAL1 circadian output lack.

qualifier: colony-stimulating factor receptor signalling
name: Colony-stimulating factor signalling in granulocyte and macrophage development
rationale: Members span G-CSF, M-CSF and GM-CSF receptor signalling with granulocyte and macrophage differentiation and proliferation, distinguishing it from CSF production, broad RUNX-driven haematopoiesis and general leukocyte differentiation neighbours.

qualifier: RUNX-driven granulopoiesis
name: RUNX-driven granulopoiesis from myeloid progenitors
rationale: Members describe RUNX1/2/3-regulated transcription and the commitment of myeloid progenitors to neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell fates with granule programmes, which separates it from erythroid-megakaryocytic, monocyte-macrophage and M-CSF neighbours.

qualifier: protein recruitment, ADP-ribosylation and NHEJ restraint
name: Chromatin remodeling and protein recruitment at double-strand breaks
rationale: All four members concern chromatin remodeling, ADP-ribosylation and protein recruitment at DSB sites that restrain NHEJ, unlike neighbours on general nucleosome assembly or the core NHEJ/ATM repair machinery.

qualifier: TLR2 recognition of Gram-positive lipopeptides and lipoteichoic acid
name: TLR2-centred Toll-like receptor sensing of Gram-positive ligands
rationale: Members cover TLR signalling and its regulation with TLR2 ligands (diacyl lipopeptide, lipoteichoic acid), which distinguishes it from LPS/TLR4-CD14 and monocyte inflammatory-response neighbours.

qualifier: production, impaired clearance and LTP suppression
name: Amyloid-beta production, impaired clearance and synaptic plasticity suppression
rationale: Members concern increased amyloid-beta formation via ectodomain shedding, reduced clearance, cellular response and LTP inhibition, distinguishing it from glial activation and amyloid fibril/clearance-promoting neighbours.

qualifier: motile cilia and sperm flagella
name: Motile cilium and sperm flagellar axoneme assembly
rationale: All members concern building motile axonemes (dynein arms, central apparatus, manchette, sperm axoneme) and their function, unlike neighbours on sperm mitochondria, left-right asymmetry, basal body multiciliogenesis or tubulin modification.

qualifier: BAF complex assembly and apoptotic nuclear dismantling
name: BAF chromatin-remodeling complex assembly and apoptotic chromatin dismantling
rationale: Members combine assembly of SWI/SNF BAF chromatin-remodeling complex variants with apoptotic DNA fragmentation, chromosome condensation and lamina breakdown; the BAF members separate it from apoptosis/necroptosis and PAK-2p34 neighbours and the apoptotic members from nucleosome-assembly neighbours.

qualifier: FGFR1 and FGFR3 with Sprouty/FGFRL1 feedback
name: FGFR1 and FGFR3 signalling and its feedback regulation
rationale: Members cover ligand binding and FRS/SHC cascades of FGFR1 and FGFR3 plus positive and negative regulation (Sprouty, FGFRL1), distinguishing it from neighbours centred on FGFR2, FGFR4 and Klotho-dependent signalling.

qualifier: BMP branch
name: BMP-centred positive and negative regulation of SMAD signalling
rationale: All members concern BMP/TGF-beta SMAD signal transduction and its up- or down-regulation, with BMP signalling distinguishing it from SMAD2/3-activin, miRNA and extracellular ligand-sequestration neighbours.

qualifier: von Willebrand factor-GPIb-IX-V axis and its variants
name: Von Willebrand factor-GPIb platelet adhesion to collagen
rationale: Members describe VWF binding to collagen and GPIb-IX-V, its ADAMTS13 cleavage and disease variants, and resulting platelet activation, unlike neighbours on platelet aggregation, collagen-integrin matrix, fibrin coagulation or factor XII contact activation.

qualifier: ferredoxin electron transfer
name: Iron-sulfur cluster assembly and ferredoxin electron transfer
rationale: Members concern Fe-S cluster biogenesis and the NADPH-ferredoxin reductase/ferredoxin system feeding TCA enzyme maturation and pregnenolone synthesis, distinguishing it from heme biosynthesis and respiratory complex assembly neighbours.

qualifier: RNA processing, modification and ribosome assembly
name: Mitochondrial RNA processing, modification and ribosome assembly
rationale: All members concern maturation of mitochondrial tRNA, rRNA and mRNA and mitoribosome assembly for mitochondrial translation, unlike neighbours on mitochondrial RNA import, pseudouridine synthesis or mitochondrial RNA decay.

qualifier: ERBB, MET and PTK6 adaptor cascades
name: ERBB, MET and PTK6 receptor tyrosine kinase signalling
rationale: Members describe EGFR/ERBB2-4, MET/HGF and PTK6 signalling through GRB2, SHC1, PI3K, PLCG1 and STAT3 (with VEGFR2, ALK/LTK and MST1 alongside), distinguishing it from EGFR down-regulation, EPO/IGF1R, FGFR/RAS-MAPK and endocytic-degradation neighbours.

qualifier: initiation, unwinding and polymerase activity
name: Mitotic cell-cycle DNA replication initiation and unwinding
rationale: Members concern initiation, DNA unwinding and polymerase activity of S-phase replication (plus E2F1 replication targets and break-induced replication), distinguishing it from ATR replication-stress checkpoint, cell division and broader E2F cell-cycle neighbours.

qualifier: structural plasticity and synapse maturation
name: Structural synaptic plasticity and synapse maturation
rationale: All members concern positive regulation of synaptic plasticity, synapse maturation and spine/structural remodeling, unlike neighbours on CREB-driven memory, dendrite arborization, postsynaptic density maintenance or LTP/LTD calcium signalling.

qualifier: bidirectional control in trabecular bone and tendon
name: Osteoblast proliferation and differentiation control in bone and tendon
rationale: Members are positive and negative regulation of osteoblast proliferation and differentiation with trabecular bone, tendon and proteoglycan synthesis, distinguishing it from neighbours on direct ossification, mineralization and Wnt-driven mesenchymal stem cell differentiation.

qualifier: ESCRT-III nuclear envelope sealing and midbody abscission
name: ESCRT-mediated nuclear envelope resealing and abscission at mitotic exit
rationale: Members concern late mitotic events - ESCRT-III nuclear envelope sealing and disassembly, nuclear membrane reassembly, abscission and cytokinesis restraint (with endoreduplication) - which neighbours centred on spindle, cohesion, chromosome condensation and contractile ring lack.

qualifier: tyrosine and phenylalanine
name: Tyrosine and phenylalanine catabolism
rationale: Members are tyrosine catabolism plus phenylalanine and general L-amino acid breakdown terms, distinguishing it from histidine, threonine and glycine/glyoxylate catabolism neighbours and from the phenylketonuria-focused neighbour.

qualifier: NAD salvage, coenzyme A synthesis and pyruvate dehydrogenase
name: NAD, coenzyme A and pyruvate dehydrogenase acetyl-CoA metabolism
rationale: Members cover NAD/NADP biosynthesis and salvage, pantothenate/CoA synthesis and PDH-catalysed pyruvate to acetyl-CoA conversion, distinguishing it from thiamine/riboflavin vitamin, TCA cycle and OGDH/lipoylation neighbours.

qualifier: ryanodine receptor restraint in skeletal muscle
name: Ryanodine receptor restraint of skeletal muscle calcium release
rationale: All four members concern limiting ryanodine-receptor release of sequestered calcium and its role in skeletal muscle contraction, unlike neighbours on SERCA calcium uptake, cardiac excitation-contraction or store-operated calcium entry.

qualifier: OATP (SLCO) hepatic uptake of drugs and bilirubin
name: OATP-mediated hepatic organic anion uptake of drugs and bilirubin
rationale: Members are sodium-independent SLCO/OATP organic anion transport, Rotor-type hyperbilirubinemia from SLCO1B1/1B3 defects, and drug ADME routes using these transporters, distinguishing it from SLC22/organic cation, xenobiotic metabolism and UGT1A1/heme-degradation neighbours.
